what: the answer key of the public accuracy sets, by version (D-1104): built at run time by tools/public_accuracy from the pinned sources, never committed; this file pins what is known of each version

v1.what: as launch P1b used it (builder of master fa639b61): birth date 1 July of the visit's year minus the age; placed age lines in years, written even when the protocol states the bound; JMED truth from the structured 主病名/既往歴/現病歴
v1.build: python -m tools.public_accuracy build --set SET --out DIR --for-box --ref DAY --key v1

launch_p1b.what: sha256 of each file of built/gold as the run stored it (written.json and key.json did not exist then)

v2.what: B1-B3 of the P1b review: B1 birth date the visit minus the stated age in its unit; B2 placed age lines keep their unit and a bound the protocol states is not written again; B3 JMED truth from the note the box reads, over the same patients as v1
v2.build: python -m tools.public_accuracy build --set SET --out DIR --for-box --ref DAY (--key v2 is the default)
v2.why_no_sha256: not built here: the sources (the SIGIR files, ClinicalTrials.gov's fields, the JMED-Personas parquet) are fetched at build time and are not in the repository; H-2 made no network call. The first v2 build adds its sha256 here as a new entry

jmed.how: key v2's truth (sets.jmed_stratum) on each note the run's judge read in full (319 of the 594 rows the box answered); the other 275 rows' notes are not in the stored run and need the source to list
jmed.birth_dates: B1 changes every JMED patient's birth date (the visit minus the age, not 1 July)

sigir.why: B1 and B2 change the site (birth dates, placed lines), not the physicians' labels; the 2 pairs whose label conflicts with the physicians' own criterion labels are the scorer's to report (S1): sigir-201413 x NCT00163709 and sigir-20142 x NCT00711399
sigir.birth_dates: 43 of 46 patients' birth dates change (the other 3 have no note in eval/criterion_ml to check here); under v1, 24 of the 43 were a year too old on the run day; sigir-201418, a 6-month-old, was born 2026-07-01 under v1 (2 months old at the visit) and is born 2026-02-28 under v2
sigir.protocol_lines: B2 changes the placed age lines (sigir-201418 x NCT01260883: 'Aged 0.17 years or older' becomes 'Aged 2 months or older'); the full list needs ClinicalTrials.gov's fields
